scope: Source fit only, not held-out calibration quality or timing evidence. Zero-frequency ties filled by token id, explicitly reported.

fits.selection: Rank by source weights descending, break ties by token id. No validation/test outcomes used.
fits.limitation: Static fit; source loss is optimistic. Prefix loss describes a frozen block and does not predict end-to-end speed.
